first_board.name: 首板接力
first_board.hypothesis: 首次收盘涨停形成关注度，次日买盘延续；预期提高次日涨停率和净收益胜率。
first_board.rule: T 日收盘涨停且前一交易日未收盘涨停。

failed_touch.name: 触板未封修复
failed_touch.hypothesis: T 日触板后未封住，次日新增买盘承接卖盘；预期提高次日涨停率和净收益胜率。
failed_touch.rule: T 日最高价达到涨停价且收盘低于涨停价。

first_pullback.name: 涨停次日阴线回调
first_pullback.hypothesis: 涨停后的首日回调吸收短期卖盘，下一交易日恢复上涨；预期提高次日涨停率和净收益胜率。
first_pullback.rule: 前一交易日收盘涨停，T 日收阴且低于前收，T 日未触板。

caliber.evidence: Path A strategy signal backtest; no production end-to-end replay
caliber.score: single declared constant-score signal through production aggregate; rank final_score then code
caliber.execution: production _simulate_outcome, current policy, T+1 exit restriction, costs; five observed stock bars
caliber.capital_utilization: mean allocated fraction per selected signal; portfolio concurrency not modelled
caliber.drawdown: additive signal-day mean net return drawdown; not account equity drawdown
caliber.accuracy: next market day high/close equals stored official up_limit within half a price tick; missing unknown
caliber.eligibility: all A share daily records; point-in-time non-ST metadata; listed at least 60 calendar days; positive volume and valid official daily limits
caliber.baseline: first_board same-day Top6; descriptive reference, not deployed champion
caliber.bootstrap: 4000 paired signal-day samples for net return difference; day-cluster resampling for accuracy; seed 20260921
caliber.source_type: canonical pattern definitions; not a reproduction of any publisher's claimed returns
caliber.w3_note: W3 uses the latest 40 observed market trading days; W3_given_dates preserves the specified 35-day interval separately
